name: Alter Stench
body:
You can alter your horrific stench to instead smell quite nice.

Prerequisite(s): Stench ability.

Benefit(s): You can alter your stench to a significantly more pleasant pheromone that puts others at ease.

While your stench is altered, you gain a +4 bonus on Bluff, Diplomacy, and Intimidate checks against creatures within the range of your stench ability instead of its normal effects. Changing your stench’s effect is a standard action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
